description: FastAPI application defining data models with Pydantic and an endpoint for updating items and users with request body parameters.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Pydantic model representing an item with optional description and tax fields.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a user with optional full_name.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: int = Body())
methods.description: Asynchronous function handling PUT requests to update an item, taking path parameter, models, and an importance value from request body.

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: int = Body()):$/
ctags.signature: (item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: int = Body())
